description: This file defines a Java interface for accessing UserEntity objects in a database, using Spring Data JPA. It declares a custom method to find users by their identification number.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for UserEntity, with a custom finder method by identification number.

methods.name: findByIdentificationNumber
methods.description: A method to retrieve a UserEntity wrapped in an Optional based on the user's identification number.
